story.title: Pirate Face Rescues LLM Models from Deletion

draft:
A rogue backup service is keeping LLM checkpoints alive when the cloud pulls the plug.

- Pirate Face lets developers snapshot any model before the host archive disappears, turning a “delete‑on‑expire” policy into a reversible safety net.  
- The platform’s peer‑to‑peer storage model sidesteps single‑point failures, which is a game‑changer for reproducibility in research labs that can’t afford to lose weeks of fine‑tuning.  
- By exposing a simple CLI, it lowers the barrier for teams to integrate version control into their model pipelines without adding heavy infrastructure.

I’m curious: what strategies are you using to protect your most valuable AI assets from unexpected deletions?
